content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms are designed to serve the majority, not the minority. When you're a creator in a restricted region, you're often forced to work around these platforms, using their APIs, and playing by their rules. But what if you could build a commerce stack that's specifically designed for your needs, without relying on a third-party? With COREMERCH, you can deploy a custom-built stack that integrates with your favorite tools, and scales with your business. We're not talking about a simple plugin or a workaround – we're talking about a complete, sovereign commerce infrastructure that's built to last.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start building your commerce stack, you need to have a few things in place. First, you need to choose a payment method that works for your region. For creators in Kenya, USDT on Tron is a great option – it settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. You'll also need to set up a Binance P2P account to accept naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings. Additionally, you'll need to have a digital product ready to sell, and a basic understanding of how to use GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Google Apps Script.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your payment method and digital product in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce stacks really shine. With our Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a custom-built payment pipeline that integrates with your favorite tools, and scales with your business. You'll also need to set up a delivery pipeline that uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your digital products to customers. With our stack, you can automate this process, and ensure that your customers receive their products quickly and efficiently.
You own your data, and your entire commerce infrastructure, with COREMERCH.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have your commerce stack set up, it's time to go live. This is the moment of truth – when you finally get to see your commerce stack in action. To process your first transaction, you'll need to configure your payment method, and set up a webhook that fires the moment payment is confirmed on-chain. With our stack, you can automate this process, and ensure that your customers receive their products quickly and efficiently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your commerce stack is live, and you've processed your first transaction, it's time to scale. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce stacks really shine. With our stack, you can deploy a custom-built payment pipeline that integrates with your favorite tools, and scales with your business. You can also use our templates and blueprints to automate the process of setting up new products, and handling customer support. With our stack, you can scale your business quickly and efficiently, without relying on a third-party.

With our sovereign commerce stacks, you can deploy a custom-built commerce infrastructure that integrates with your favorite tools, and scales with your business. And, with our Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack – instantly.
Our sovereign commerce stacks are built to last, and scale with your business.

And, if you're ready to get started, be sure to visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with COREMERCH, follow these steps: choose a payment method that works for your region, set up a Binance P2P account to accept local currencies, have a digital product ready to sell, set up a GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Google Apps Script account, configure your payment method, set up a webhook that fires the moment payment is confirmed on-chain, automate your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and scale your business using our templates and blueprints.
